main_text.p: modò deficientis, modò lucis suæ amplitudinem postliminio recipientis, prostratos humi animos potenter erigunt corroborántque. Quo posteriori in consolationum genere utramque paginam prædictiones Divino Spiritu fusæ, & in Ecclesiæ solius ταμεῖῳ repositæ faciunt. Et in Novo quidem Testamento Regni Christi incunabula, incrementa, progressum adversùs Sathanæ, rufi illius Draconis, organorumque ejus in mundo pestilentissimorum, nefaria molimina & impedimenta undequaque objecta, certamina Sanctorum certaminumque illorum admirabilem catastrophen Divi Johannis Theologi Apocalypsis, mysteriis, temporum jam face clarissimè detectis plerisque, refertissima, repræsentat. Quid enim Ecclesiæ Christianæ commodo, quæ funestissimis hisce temporibus à mundo & principe ejus vehementissimè oppugnatur, ordinari, disponi, dari aut doceri ad piorum consolationem confirmationemque securam sapientius potuit, quam ille S. Johannis disertissimæ præsignificationes, plerequejam rebus

page.notes: Greek word in the line "solius ταμείῳ repositæ" is transcribed as printed but uncertain: ταμεῖῳ[?]. Lines are set in a dense, partly smudged font; words such as "Satanæ" (printed "Satha-næ"), "Sanctorum" and "plerisque" were read with some doubt. Watermark "Digitized by Google" at bottom right is excluded.
